changelog: Adds automatic confidence-scored theme discovery via YouTube, SoundCloud, and anime Bilibili with full metadata rechecks, wrong-year and fan-made rejection, conservative ambiguity handling, and upgraded retry keys.
description: Finds missing TV series themes via stable-ID overrides, ThemerrDB, AnimeThemes, Plex, and conservative automatic discovery from YouTube, SoundCloud, and Bilibili (anime only), saving validated theme.mp3 files without overwriting existing themes.
name: Theme Music Finder
overview: Finds missing TV series theme music and saves it as theme.mp3.
